sql: with f as (select split_part(f.market_ticker,'-',1) as series, f.market_ticker, max(coalesce((f.raw_fill_json->>'created_time')::timestamptz, f.filled_at)) as last_fill from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and split_part(f.market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXMLBHR','KXATPCHALLENGERMATCH','KXITFWMATCH','KXITFMATCH','KXMLBTOTAL','KXBTCD','KXMLBSPREAD','KXRAIN','KXWCGOAL','KXMLBKS','KXWTI','KXWTACHALLENGERMATCH','KXNFLTOTAL') group by 1,2), r as (select *, row_number() over (partition by series order by last_fill desc) as rn, count(*) over (partition by series) as n, min(last_fill) over (partition by series) as first_fill from f) select series, market_ticker, last_fill, rn, n, first_fill from r where rn <= 3 order by series, rn
